description: The requestor's landing page: four counters across the top that double as filters, and a server-paginated table of their own requests underneath. It is the only place a USER sees the whole set, and the row click is how every other request page is reached.

happy_path.result: Total, Pending, Approved, Rejected across every request they have ever filed
the table filters to that status group; pressing the same one again clears it
the server re-queries; the page resets to 1 on every filter change

alternate_paths.name: No requests at all
alternate_paths.result: the empty state explains what the page is for and offers New Request as its action

alternate_paths.name: No results for the filter
alternate_paths.trigger: search or status filter matches nothing
alternate_paths.result: a different empty state that names the filter and offers to clear it — never the same message as 'no requests yet'

alternate_paths.name: Query fails
alternate_paths.result: AppQueryError with a retry that refetches; the counters and the table fail independently

alternate_paths.name: Account switched
alternate_paths.trigger: the user signs out and in as another role
alternate_paths.result: the list refetches on mount rather than serving the previous account's cached page

trpc_procedures.name: myList
guards: where.userId is always ctx.user.id — never an input
trpc_procedures.description: Paginated list of the caller's own requests. masterStatus accepts either a literal status or a GROUP key: PENDING expands to the five in-flight statuses, REJECTED to the five terminal rejections. Search matches title or documentNumber, case-insensitive. Default order is createdAt desc.

trpc_procedures.name: mySummary
guards: all four counts are scoped to ctx.user.id
trpc_procedures.description: Four counts in one transaction. pending = the five in-flight statuses, approved = APPROVED only, rejected = the five terminal rejections. DRAFT, RETURNED, FOR_NEXT_YEAR_PPMP and COMPLETED are deliberately in total and in none of the other three.

components.description: Four AppKpi tiles: Total (icon FileText), Pending (Clock), Approved (CheckCircle), Rejected (XCircle). Each is pressable and sets the status filter; the active one is visibly selected. No delta chip — there is no previous period to compare against, and AppKpi's delta requires a named comparison.

hooks.note: Wraps request.myList and request.mySummary. refetchOnMount: 'always' — signing in as a different account previously served the old account's cached page until a manual refresh (IRMS-old TASKS.md).

functional: Filter, search and page live in the URL as search params, validated with a Zod schema using .catch defaults, so a link to a filtered page is shareable and the back button works.
Any filter or search change resets page to 1 — page 7 of a filter with two results is an empty table with no explanation.
The counters are a filter, not decoration: pressing one sets the status group, pressing the active one clears it.

Status groups: PENDING = SUBMITTED, UNDER_IDO_REVIEW, UNDER_DIRECTOR_REVIEW, UNDER_IDO_FINAL_REVIEW, UNDER_FINAL_DIRECTOR_REVIEW. REJECTED = REJECTED_BY_IDO, BUDGET_OFFICER_REJECTED, DIRECTOR_REJECTED, IDO_FINAL_REJECTED, FINAL_REJECTED.

The status filter offers the six groups from FILTER_OPTIONS (Draft, Returned by IDO, Under Review, Approved, Rejected, Completed) plus All — not the fifteen raw statuses, which is a requestor's list of jargon.
Search is debounced 300ms and matches title or documentNumber, case-insensitive.
Sorting is offered on Date Filed only. The other columns have no meaningful order and offering the control implies one exists.
The list refetches on mount so a fresh sign-in never renders the previous session's rows.
authorization: Route gate: assertAuthenticatedRoleFn with allowedRoles ['USER'] — staff have their own dashboard.
Server gate: myList and mySummary scope every query to ctx.user.id. There is no userId input, so no crafted call can read another requestor's list.
A staff member who deep-links to /requests is redirected to /unauthorized by the route gate; even if they were not, the queries would return their own (empty) list, never someone else's.
ux: Two distinct empty states: 'No requests yet' with a New Request action, and 'No requests match your filters' with a clear-filters action. Showing the first while a filter is active tells the user their history is gone.
A row count line — 'Showing 1-10 of 34 requests' — sits above the table whenever there are results.
Loading is a skeleton in the table body and in the counters, not a spinner that replaces the page; the filters stay usable while a page loads.
The table and the counters fail independently — one AppQueryError does not blank the other.
Doc. # renders '—' for a draft, because a draft genuinely has no number yet.

server_guards.guard: all four counts scoped to ctx.user.id

covers: a user sees only their own requests when two users have requests
masterStatus 'PENDING' expands to the five in-flight statuses
masterStatus 'REJECTED' expands to the five terminal rejections
masterStatus 'DRAFT' filters on the literal status
total counts every request including drafts
rejected includes all five rejection statuses
approved counts APPROVED and not COMPLETED
a new account sees the no-requests-yet empty state with a New Request action
a search that matches nothing shows the no-results empty state with clear filters
pressing the Pending counter filters the table and pressing it again clears the filter
a filter change resets the page to 1
a staff role deep-linking to /requests lands on /unauthorized

acceptance_criteria.then: 10 rows render, the count line reads 'Showing 1-10 of 34 requests' and pagination offers 4 pages

acceptance_criteria.given: a USER on page 3 with no filter
acceptance_criteria.then: the URL page resets to 1 and the results match the term
the table shows exactly those 5 and the tile renders as selected
no row belonging to user B is returned

acceptance_criteria.given: a draft with no document number
acceptance_criteria.then: the Doc. # cell shows '—' rather than 'null' or an empty cell

edge_cases: Filter changes must reset the page or the user lands on an out-of-range page with an empty table and no explanation.
The counters and the list are two queries; after any mutation elsewhere both must be invalidated or the tiles disagree with the rows.
Signing out and in as a different role previously served stale rows — refetchOnMount: 'always' on this query is the fix, and it must not be dropped as an optimisation.
COMPLETED sits in total but in none of pending/approved/rejected. That is intentional; do not 'fix' the arithmetic so the three add up to the total.
Search on documentNumber must be case-insensitive even though the format is numeric — the year prefix and any future letter suffix make a plain equality match wrong.
out_of_scope: The staff queue — spec 009, a different query with role-shaped scoping.
Bulk actions, CSV export and column picking — the old app had none and nothing asks for them.
Notifications when a request changes status — no notification system exists.
